messages.subject: data.frame and shiny-server
parts:
Is it possible to use HTML in a data.frame in a shiny app? I've used HTML in other parts of my app, but data.frame is being picky. I would really love for the column headers of the table to be in HTML because I am using mathematical symbols. Or any suggestions other than data.frame?


Also, I'm trying to set up shiny server on RHEL 5. I have already done it on an RHEL 6 machine and it works great, but on the RHEL 5 machine I'm running into a lot of problems setting it up. Node.js will never go to the right place and the documented installation instructions aren't working.. Will shiny server just not work on RHEL 5?


Thanks!
